title: Finite equations for the closed fibre-degree sublevel locus on an affine open
statement: Let f : X → S be a flat, locally finitely presented, separated, quasi-finite morphism of schemes, r a natural number, and W an affine open of S. Assume the fibre-degree-at-most-r locus is closed, that for every g : T → S the base change of f is finite locally free of degree r if and only if the image of g lies in the fibre-degree-r locus, and that every point of W has fibre degree at least r (the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-qf-degree-successor-affine-compact-aux). Then there is a finite set t of sections of Γ(S,W) such that, for every s in W, the fibre degree at s is at most r if and only if s lies outside D(a) for every a in t.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Tag 07RZ, proof, second paragraph

proof.text: Apply the specialized finite-generation lemma to the closed degree sublevel locus, then apply the finite-generator basic-open characterization.

theorem exists_finite_equations_degree_sublevel_inter_affine
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [IsSeparated f] (hf : f.IsQuasiFinite)
    (r : ℕ) (W : S.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hclosed : IsClosed {s : S | (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).finrankΓ ≤ r})
    (hdegree : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S),
      (pullback.snd f g).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree r ↔
        Set.range g ⊆ {s : S | (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).finrankΓ = r})
    (hWge : ∀ s : S, s ∈ W → r ≤ (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).finrankΓ) :
    ∃ t : Finset Γ(S, W), ∀ s : S, s ∈ W →
      ((f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).finrankΓ ≤ r ↔ ∀ a ∈ t, s ∉ S.basicOpen a)
